title: Bodycam Video Shows Police Tackling 60 Year-Old Woman
description:
On April 28th, 2022, officers responded to 911 call about a house break in. The suspect had run away by the time police arrived. Soon, she was located and officers tried to make contact with her. She slipped out of her handcuffs, causing the officers to tackle her once again. She continued to resist, giving the officers a very hard time. A supervisor then asks the officers a few questions and tries to ensure that they got the right suspect.The female was charged with criminal trespass and resisting arrest.
